name: eSUN (Shenzhen Esun Industrial Co., Ltd.)
summary: Founded 2002 in Shenzhen, eSUN is one of the oldest and highest-volume Chinese filament and resin producers (~30,000 t/yr capacity, NEEQ-listed, stock 836514). It sells under its own eSUN brand and is a major upstream OEM whose production reaches many budget retail labels.

oem_relationships.notes: User-verified (research/verified-oem-relationships.md); round spool cutout indicates eSUN production (diamond = Polymaker). Spool-cutout identification is the only evidence found; not corroborated by either company's own materials.
User-verified (research/verified-oem-relationships.md). 3dHojor is a retail label with no independent manufacturing presence.
User-verified; Bambu resells eSUN/Polymaker and Sunlu production — line-level mapping still unresolved (research/verified-oem-relationships.md open questions).

product_lines.name: PLA+
product_lines.notes: Impact-modifier-toughened PLA; density 1.24 g/cm3, no chemistry change vs base PLA (TDS V4.0).

product_lines.name: PLA-Basic
product_lines.notes: Unmodified economy PLA.

product_lines.name: PLA-ST
product_lines.notes: "Specialized technical" PLA positioned above PLA+: impact/heat-modified toughened PLA, same lactide base.

product_lines.name: PLA-HF
product_lines.notes: High-flow PLA for high-speed printers.

product_lines.name: eSilk-PLA (PLA-Silk Candy / Mystic / Magic)
product_lines.notes: PLA + luster additive; density 1.21 g/cm3, tensile 52 MPa, elongation 14.4% (TDS V4.0). Candy/Mystic/Magic are multi-colour silk SKUs.

product_lines.name: PLA-Matte
product_lines.notes: Matte-additive PLA.

product_lines.name: PLA-Marble
product_lines.notes: Mineral/pigment marble-effect PLA; no chemistry change, no dedicated marble id in catalog.

product_lines.name: PLA-Coffee
product_lines.notes: Organic coffee-residue filler in PLA; not wood flour, so pla-wood does not apply.

product_lines.name: PLA-Luminous Rainbow
product_lines.notes: Phosphorescent pigment plus along-strand colour gradient on a PLA base.

product_lines.name: PLA-LW
product_lines.notes: Chemically foamed lightweight PLA; density drops in-nozzle with temperature.

product_lines.name: PLA-Cast
product_lines.notes: Castable burnout PLA — no catalog id covers castable/burnout formulations.

product_lines.name: PETG / PETG-Basic / PETG+
product_lines.notes: Standard and enhanced amorphous PETG copolyester grades.

product_lines.name: PETG-UV Color Change
product_lines.notes: PETG carrying a UV-photochromic pigment; base chemistry unchanged.

product_lines.name: ABS+HS
product_lines.notes: High-strength ABS grade.

product_lines.name: ABS-ESD
product_lines.notes: ABS + conductive filler for static dissipation; catalog has petg-esd but no ABS ESD id.

product_lines.name: ASA
product_lines.notes: Standard acrylonitrile styrene acrylate.

product_lines.name: PET-FR
product_lines.notes: Flame-retardant unmodified PET; chemistry is pet, but no pet-fr id exists (compare abs-fr).

product_lines.name: PA
product_lines.notes: Unfilled polyamide; PA type not stated in the catalog listing, so no pa6/pa12 grade id.

product_lines.name: ePA-CF (PA-CF)
product_lines.notes: Nylon 6/66 copolymer + 20% carbon fiber; density 1.24 g/cm3, tensile 84.05 MPa XY / 50.34 MPa Z. Copolymer base, not straight PA6. Remapped pa6-cf -> pa-cf (generic copolymer nylon-CF) per its own PA6/66-copolymer chemistry note; Fable review 2026-08-01.

product_lines.name: ePA12-CF (PA12-CF)
product_lines.notes: PA12 + carbon fiber, ~120 C heat resistance (TDS V4.01).

product_lines.name: TPU-95A
product_lines.notes: Shore 95A flexible TPU.

product_lines.name: TPU-64D
product_lines.notes: Shore 64D rigid-flexible TPU; tpu-68d carries "TPU 64D" as an alias.

product_lines.name: TPE-83A
product_lines.notes: Shore 83A thermoplastic elastomer, not a urethane; no 83A-specific TPE grade id.

product_lines.name: PEBA-90A / PEBA-85A
product_lines.notes: Polyether block amide elastomer (Pebax-class), not TPU or SEBS TPE; high-rebound footwear/sports material. No catalog id.

product_lines.name: PEBA-LW
product_lines.notes: Foamed lightweight PEBA; no catalog id.

product_lines.name: PVA
product_lines.notes: Water-soluble support.

product_lines.name: HIPS
product_lines.notes: High-impact polystyrene, support/sacrificial use.

product_lines.name: Clean (Cleaning Filament)
product_lines.notes: Purge/cleaning compound, not a print material.

additional_notes: Roughly 43 filament SKUs across ~10 material families, plus photopolymer resins, PCL and lactate esters. Sub-entities: iSUN3D (custom printing systems) and wholly-owned Xiaogan Esun New Material Co., Ltd. Manufacturing in Shenzhen (Guangdong), Xiaogan industrial park (Hubei) and a Vietnam facility operating since 2019; branches in Wuhan, Beijing, Hong Kong and the US. National High-Tech Enterprise; ranked top-10 among Chinese degradable-plastics producers. Western retail PLA typically $15-20/kg (exact figure unverified), so 'mid' is a close call against 'budget'. Whether eSUN sells build plates/print surfaces was not established, so makes_plates is left unset.

provenance.conflicts: The Inland and Bambu Lab relationships are owner-verified but externally uncorroborated: the Inland link rests only on spool-cutout identification (round = eSUN, diamond = Polymaker), and which Bambu Lab lines come from eSUN vs Polymaker vs Sunlu is unresolved. Price tier sits on the budget/mid boundary; no verified $/kg figure was found.
